def listSum : List Nat → Nat
| [] => 0
| x::xs => x + listSum xs

def listMin : List Nat → Nat
| [] => 0
| [x] => x
| x::xs => min x (listMin xs)

def secondMin : List Nat → Nat
| [] => 0
| [_] => 0
| l =>
  let m := listMin l
  listMin (l.filter (fun x => x ≠ m))
